title: Exact Likelihood-Coin Poisson Sampling for Bayesian Inverse Problems with Sharp Complexity Bounds
summary: We develop an exact posterior-sampling framework for Bayesian inverse problems when selected bounded forward observables can be accessed through Bernoulli events. A Bernstein--Poisson construction converts these forward coins into scaled Gaussian likelihood coins, and thinning an inflated prior Poisson point process yields posterior atoms that are iid conditional on their number.
